accepted_eta_mutations: from_initial_state_with_diagnostics owns initializer eta; mean starts uncomputed
accept_trial swaps eta and mean; validity must swap with them
trial_eta_mutations: fill_line_search_trial invalidates first; may write only a prefix before error
accept_trial swaps in former accepted eta/mean/tag
trial_mean_other_writes: evaluate_candidate_objective reuses trial_mean for candidate_eta and invalidates the trial tag before mean writes; partial/error exits remain invalid
mean_consumers: refresh_working_state may reuse only matching checked bounds; changed bounds force established domain/exponential checks
working weights and responses always recomputed from current outcome, prior weights, offset, eta and mean
score residuals, objective, strict checkpoint, final synchronization and inference retain their checks
memory: Two Option<PoissonBounds> fields, 40 bytes each in actual arm64 diagnostic artifacts. Workspace size is 336 -> 416 bytes. No new heap/vector; current/trial workspace remains locally owned by the prepared driver. All four untraced native action peaks and models are exact and admitted. This is no peak-memory saving.
scope: Mean validity only; no weighted design, basis, moment, topology, or certificate authority is inferred from the tag.
source_derived_cost: Each valid reuse skips one N-element eta read, N-element mean write, N exponentials and their domain tests. Working weights/response/score still refresh. Observed full-data reused call counts are 4 complete, 5 FW, 4 narrow. Payload counts are logical work, not hardware bandwidth.
